_how_to_use: Each entry in releases shows as a card on /presave/ with its cover, date and a Pre-save button. presave_url empty = no button (the card still shows). release_date empty = 'Coming soon'. Put the newest release first. The old single presave_url field still works as a fallback card.

releases.title: Blue Eyes
releases.blurb: A slow country tribute to my dad. Hitting Spotify and every other store any day now.
